_comment: Per-market settings, selected by VINTED_DOMAIN in .env (e.g. 'it' -> www.vinted.it).
To support a new market, copy an entry and adapt it; no Python changes needed.
Any scalar key can also be overridden from .env (see .env.example).
currency                currency code sent with drafts/edits (EUR, SEK, ...)
locale                  value of the 'locale' header (affects language of API labels)
price_format            how prices are printed/logged; {amount} is replaced
preferred_catalog_root  when a category keyword matches several catalogs, prefer the
ones whose path contains this text (null = take Vinted's order).
catalog_aliases         local names for categories -> catalog id (ids are global).
Checked before Vinted's live keyword search. Must be leaf
categories. List them with `vinted catalogs` (no keyword).
default_size_group      size group used by `--size L` / `vinted sizes` (14 = men's tops)
condition_aliases       extra local names for conditions -> id (ids are global:
6 new with tags, 1 new without tags, 2 very good, 3 good, 4 satisfactory)
material_aliases        local names for materials -> id
brand_prices            fixed price per brand, in this market's currency; brands not
listed fall back to Vinted's price suggestion
